key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; DXY remains soft but ECB hike risk looms
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path
Australia softened LNG gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears (Santos, Woodside)
High-end property prices correcting while affordable segment remains resilient
Superannuation reform debate intensifying with One Nation proposals and structural critiques
Oil price surge driving 30c fuel price increase, pressuring consumer staples and transport

sectors.trend: Sharp decline; iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, Chinese inflation surge signals demand softness. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength. Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital-raising pressure.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside. Gold miners (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer relative safety. Battery tech (Critical Resources) in positive testing phase.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rising bond yields and growth scare. RBA rental inflation concern suggests prolonged restrictive policy, squeezing NIMs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk. Rising yields support bond portfolios but equity valuations under pressure.

sectors.trend: Oil price surge ('suppression fails') benefits producers but raises input costs. Australia's softened LNG reservation rules support Santos and Woodside export flexibility.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from policy easing. Fuel cost pass-through pressures WES.AX, BWS.AX margins.

sectors.trend: Woolworths price-freeze breach and 30c fuel rise squeeze household budgets. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals consumer weakness.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin and volume pressure. Defensive positioning in staples warranted.

sectors.trend: High-end property correcting sharply; affordable segment resilient. RBA rental inflation concern supports REIT occupancy but pressures valuations. NZ housing correction in 5th year.
sectors.implications: High-end residential REITs under pressure. Industrial and healthcare REITs relatively insulated. Migrant-driven demand a structural support.

sectors.trend: Neurizon (ASX runner) and HIVE/BUZZ HPC AI cloud expansion signal niche tech momentum. Wipro AI freeing 20,000-worker capacity globally.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Small-cap tech (Neurizon, HIVE) speculative but trending.

key_themes: ASX $90bn weekly selloff driven by rate fears and oil surge
Iron ore demand deterioration from China
AUD weakness on growth scare; FX risk for importers
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Superannuation reform political debate (One Nation, structural critiques)
LNG policy easing as strategic shift
Housing bifurcation: high-end correction vs affordable resilience
Chinese inflation and geopolitical risk (Arctic shipping, India summit)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to FMG.AX, RIO.AX; diversify into gold and battery metals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA prolonged restrictive cycle / rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour floating-rate debt; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and consumer exposure; favour energy producers (STO.AX, WDS.AX)
Overweight domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy retailers
Reduce China-revenue exposure; monitor Chinese inflation and policy response
Monitor One Nation proposals; favour large diversified fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery metals on iron ore weakness
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting shifts capital to alternative metals; Kuniko and Gateway WA in active exploration; Critical Resources battery tech in positive testing

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy producers on oil surge and LNG policy easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failing; Australia's softened gas reservation rules improve export flexibility for Santos and Woodside

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Growth scare and rate uncertainty favour low-beta, dividend-paying defensives

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed mining weight
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and Chinese inflation/demand risk create sustained downside for BHP, RIO, FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight high-end property and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; RBA rental inflation focus implies prolonged tight policy

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with domestic-revenue equities
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import-cost inflation pressures margins

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Iron ore weakness, oil-driven fuel inflation, and RBA hawkish tilt on rental inflation cap upside. Expect volatility around RBA communications and Chinese data prints. $90bn weekly drawdown may extend.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA pivots. LNG policy easing supports energy sector. Housing bifurcation continues; affordable segment resilient. Superannuation reform could create structural tailwinds for fund managers. Key risk: Chinese demand deterioration.
